description:
Connect your PropertyMe account via the AiMe Connect MCP server to explore portfolio information in everyday language.

Review team workload and open tasks, find properties and contacts, monitor lease renewals and tenancy dates, track inspections and maintenance jobs, and more.
Ask questions across your PropertyMe Advanced portfolios to identify upcoming expiries, overdue actions, work that needs attention, and completed activities.

AiMe Connect uses your existing access permissions and is designed for property managers across Australia and New Zealand.

defaultPrompt: I'm about to call [contact name]. Give me a quick briefing of what they might want to discuss.
Create a spreadsheet of jobs completed this month, grouped by property. Include job name, type, completion date, and supplier
List everyone on my team, then show me the open items assigned to each person. Flag anything that's stuck or needs my attention.
